Hi @elanlearns , following up on this question with three days left. Our team is also preparing two writeups (a paper and a resource). The form still shows "You've already submitted to this competition. To submit this writeup, you'll first need to unsubmit your previous writeup."

1. Can a team have two writeups submitted at the same time so that both are judged? If not, should teams merge everything into one writeup?
2. Can an already-submitted writeup be edited before the deadline without unsubmitting it? If unsubmitting is required, does the tie-break ("the Paper that was entered first") use the first submission time or the latest one?

Thank you!
